html:
The Rhenish-Westphalian Technical School

Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule (RWTH)

Sounds like a match for my other alma mater, the Majiagou Men’s Vocational and Technical School (a jokey nickname for Harbin Institute of Technology, after the Majiagou River that runs past it and its overwhelmingly male student body).


Also known as:

RWTH Aachen University

One of Germany’s TU9 (similar to China’s C9 League) and a member of the IDEA League (current members: TU Delft, ETH Zurich, RWTH Aachen, Chalmers University of Technology and Politecnico di Milano)
